scope: Manual verification checklists for benchmark images; not a manufacturing SOP approval
fallback: Hold the screw for manual inspection of the highlighted area; compare with a good reference screw.

manipulated_front.A: Compare the highlighted screw tip with a good reference screw under the same view and lighting.
manipulated_front.B: Inspect the highlighted tip outline from another view to verify its shape.

scratch_head.A: Inspect the highlighted screw head under angled light for a visible surface mark.
scratch_head.B: Compare the highlighted head surface with a good reference screw.

scratch_neck.A: Inspect the highlighted shank below the head under angled light for a surface mark.
scratch_neck.B: Compare the highlighted shank surface with a good reference screw.

thread_side.A: Inspect the highlighted thread flank and compare its profile with a good reference screw.
thread_side.B: View the highlighted thread from another angle to verify the visible response.

thread_top.A: Inspect the highlighted thread crest and compare it with a good reference screw.
thread_top.B: View the highlighted thread crest under angled light to verify the visible response.

unknown.A: Manually inspect the highlighted area and compare it with a good reference screw.
unknown.B: Verify image quality and orientation, then capture another image for comparison.
